data: Microsoft reported revenue of $245,122 million (about $245.1 billion) for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, and net income of $88,136 million (about $88.1 billion). Revenue rose from $211,915 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of $33,207 million, or roughly 15.7%. Net income grew about 21.8% from $72,361 million in fiscal 2023. Diluted earnings per share were $11.80, up from $9.68 a year earlier. Fiscal 2024 revenue included $5,729 million contributed by the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
